tools.name: gem_properties
tools.description: Everything Digital Gemology has on one gemstone: refractive index (both rays for doubly refractive stones), birefringence, dispersion, specific gravity, hardness, crystal system, critical angle, what a refractometer, polariscope and dichroscope show, its pleochroic colors and the lines and bands a h

tools.name: identify_gem
tools.description: Match a stone's test readings against the 36 gemstones in Digital Gemology's data and rank them, saying which reading fits and which does not. Give any of: refractive index, birefringence, specific gravity, optic character, pleochroism, a spectrum line, or that the refractometer read over the limit.

tools.name: compare_gemstones
tools.description: Two gemstones side by side, and the tests that tell them apart: refractive index, birefringence (doubling of back facets, polariscope), specific gravity, dispersion (fire), hardness, pleochroism and spectrum, each with the free tool that shows it. For questions like 'how do I tell diamond from moiss

tools.name: absorption_spectrum
tools.description: What a hand spectroscope shows for one gemstone: each absorption line and band with its position in nanometres, its cause (for example Cr3+ in ruby) and what it looks like, from Digital Gemology's Spectroscope or, for the stones it does not model, published references.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "gem_properties" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
